disclosure: Response-time figures reflect widely cited speed-to-lead research (e.g., Lead Response Management study, Harvard Business Review); not a Black Arrow-run study.

claims.text: Industry research indicates most service businesses take over an hour to respond to a new lead, and only about 17% reply within the first 60 minutes.
Industry research also indicates responding within 5 minutes can roughly double the odds of closing a lead compared to slower response times.
Black Arrow offers a free tool that times and audits your speed-to-lead performance.
